item.title: Alumni Athlete Feature: Molly Boyle ’25
item.description: As a two-year Co-Captain of Girls Hockey, a one-year Co-Captain of the Field Hockey team, and a member of Girls Lacrosse, Molly Boyle ’25 left Andover with a standout athletic legacy. She now competes for Yale University (Yale)’s Division I Women’s Hockey team, where she was named the East Coast Athletic Conference (ECAC) Women’s Rookie of the Month this past November. In addition to her collegiate success, Boyle also represented Team USA at the 2024 International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF)...

item.title: Students Participate in Anti-ICE Sit-In
item.description: Students gathered on the steps of Samuel Phillips Hall during 7th Period as a part of a walk-out and sit-in. The demonstration was organized by Kristen Ma ’27 and Vivi Plouffe ’27 in response to U.S. Immigration and Customs (ICE) agents’ recent actions. Attendees gave speeches, held discussions, and used music to express their beliefs on current events. Read full coverage on this event in next Friday’s issue (2/20).
